dimensions.evidenceA: Repentance and baptism precede the promised reception in Peter’s instruction.
dimensions.evidenceB: Spirit reception precedes the command for water baptism in the narrated event.
dimensions.label: Sequence

dimensions.evidenceA: Those receiving Peter’s word are baptized and added.
dimensions.evidenceB: Languages and praise persuade the Jewish believers that Gentiles received the gift.
dimensions.label: Recognition

evidence.observation: Peter calls the hearers to repent and be baptized, and says they will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
The Holy Spirit falls while Peter is speaking, and water baptism is ordered afterward.

record.tension: Acts 2 presents baptism before the promised gift in Peter’s instruction, while Acts 10 narrates the Spirit falling before water baptism.
record.title: When does the Spirit come relative to water baptism?
